_doc: Pellet boost + cost (Steve 2026-11-08 07:03 CST reframe: the pellet bearer gains basically unlimited food boosts, WITH A COST; 11:54 CST correction: the cost is HEALTH — radiation poisoning, Fallout-style — not pantry calories). Each paid boost adds radiation exposure to the BEARER (radsPerBoost); exposure clears slowly on quiet days (radsDecayPerDay) and a cure clears it faster (radsCureDrop). At radsSickAt exposure the bearer sickens (radiation_sickness); the boost keeps working at any exposure — the power never cuts off. The free floor (floorMult) is the reactor's steady hum and costs nothing; the paid boost (boostMult) is per strike, bearer only, scholar and villager alike. A paid boost also marks a feast-surge spend (Q4: a surge counts even when the spender can't eat anymore).
note: Bearer-only. Scholar-bearer: the scholar's strikes. Villager-bearer: that villager's strikes. Party members get nothing. The free floor never marks a surge spend (it costs nothing, so it is not a spend). Radiation lives on the person: passing the pellet does not pass the poisoning.
